description_en: Modifies the switch time for operations and maintenance (O&M) events on a ClickHouse Community-compatible cluster
description_zh: 修改Clickhouse社区兼容版集群运维事件的切换时间
name: ModifyActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en: The O\&M task IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The time to initiate the switch operation. The time is in UTC and the format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 后台发起切换操作的时间点，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately execute the O\&M task. Valid values:

1: Execute immediately.

0: Execute at the specified time
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即执行运维任务，取值：

1：立即执行。
0：指定时间执行
parameters.name: immediate_start

Ids.description_en: The O\&M event IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas (,)
Ids.description_zh: 运维事件 ID，多个 ID 间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
